loops.note: First honest pass. Every piece built, integrated and judged against Pleco and Du Chinese by a critic with fresh context that ran the app itself. All nine fail — but the blind judges, shown our screen and a reference screen without being told which was which, picked ours for the quiz, the summary and the vocabulary list. What fails is behaviour and data, not craft.
